claims.label: Rooftop footage depicts a movement identified by host as lateral/military crawl
claims.claim: The footage shown depicts an individual performing what the host identifies, with reference to a side-by-side military reference clip, as a "lateral crawl."
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the original unaltered footage, authenticate source chain, and have independent military-tactics experts assess whether the movement matches the lateral-crawl technique as shown in the reference clip.

claims.label: Rooftop footage shows no clearly visible muzzle flash
claims.claim: During the rooftop segment held before the shooter rises to flee, no muzzle flash is clearly visible in the displayed footage.
claims.investigative_direction: Submit original footage for frame-by-frame forensic analysis and compare with reference muzzle-flash signatures for the alleged weapon type.

claims.label: Rooftop footage shows no visible recoil/kickback
claims.claim: In the displayed footage, the shooter is not shown exhibiting visible recoil or kickback consistent with the alleged weapon (German 98 Mouser family heirloom) at the moment of firing.
claims.investigative_direction: Frame-by-frame forensic review of original footage; cross-reference with recoil physics of the alleged firearm model.

claims.label: A back-and-forth flash is visible during the rooftop crawl
claims.claim: A flash or back-and-forth light phenomenon is visible in the rooftop footage during the individual's crawl.
claims.investigative_direction: Slow-motion forensic review of original footage to determine whether the flash is environmental (reflective surface, vehicle light) or item-related (signal mirror, flag, etc.).

claims.label: Wikipedia article on John C. Phelan contains a "Relationship with Jeffrey Epstein" subsection
claims.claim: The displayed Wikipedia article on John C. Phelan (Secretary of the Navy) contains a tab/subsection titled "Relationship with Jeffrey Epstein."
claims.investigative_direction: Verify current Wikipedia article state at archive.org snapshots and cross-reference with original Epstein document releases.

claims.label: Wikipedia states Phelan flew on Epstein's plane on February 27, 2006 (JFK to Luton)
claims.claim: The Wikipedia article states that Phelan flew on Jeffrey Epstein's plane on February 27, 2006, from JFK International Airport to London Luton Airport, per passenger manifests released by the U.S. House Committee in October 2025.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify against the released October 2025 House Committee manifest documents.

claims.label: Wikipedia states Phelan flew with Jean-Luc Brunel on Epstein's plane on March 3, 2006
claims.claim: The Wikipedia article states that Phelan flew on Epstein's plane on March 3, 2006, from London to New York, with twelve other passengers including modeling agent Jean-Luc Brunel, per the released manifest.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify against released October 2025 House Committee manifest documents and cross-reference Brunel's known 2006 travel.

claims.label: Tyler Robinson texted that he was "hoping that pooch has a bad sniffer"
claims.claim: Tyler Robinson sent a text message stating, "When I checked the area about 3 hours ago, there was an officer with a canine walking nearby the area. I'm hoping that pooch has a bad sniffer."
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the underlying court exhibit / text record image to verify exact wording, sender, recipient, and timestamp.

claims.claim: The Iranian Lego propaganda video shown contains repeated lyrics/text referencing "Epstein" and "Epstein, Epstein, Epstein."
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm by independent review of the video file; verify whether the video is officially Iranian-state-affiliated or third-party.

claims.label: Erika Kirk is shown using the phrase "be a table" in TPUSA chapter-leader context
claims.claim: A clip shows Erika Kirk instructing TPUSA chapter leaders, "Be a table," and elaborating that when one's table is destroyed, one should become "a roving table yourself."
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain original clip and full context (event, date, audience).

claims.label: Becca proposes bullet fragments could have been lodged in gauze placed in Charlie Kirk's wound
claims.claim: Viewer Becca proposes that bullet fragments potentially lodged in gauze placed in Charlie Kirk's wound could account for bullet-mismatch findings, asking whether the gloves seen at the door were related. Host acknowledges possibility but suggests a medical-examiner-route alternative.
claims.investigative_direction: Review medical examiner reports and chain-of-custody records for any gauze or material handling; verify bullet-fragment provenance.

claims.label: Jacob Morrison asserts rooftop flash is a position signal; host concurs action appears professional
claims.claim: Viewer Jacob Morrison asserts the rooftop flash is a signal that the shooter was in position. Host concurs: "Sure did look like a professional."
claims.investigative_direction: Forensic review of the flash frame-by-frame; compare with published time-to-adjust-sights benchmarks for similar firearms.

claims.label: Host Says White House Employee Confirmed a Kolvet White House Meeting
claims.claim: The host says a White House employee confirmed to her that a White House meeting was on the books for Andrew Kolvet, the TPUSA chief marketing officer, the chief operating officer Justin Streiff and in-house counsel Frank, and that it fell on or near the day Benjamin Netanyahu was in town.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the White House visitor or scheduling records for the week of the Netanyahu visit and ask TPUSA and the White House to confirm or deny the meeting.
claims.transcript_snippet: I was also able to confirm with a White House employee that there certainly was a White House meeting on the books for Andrew Kolvet

claims.label: Host Says Meeting Was Cancelled Before Kolvet Denied It
claims.claim: The host says a White House source corroborated the meeting, then told her the meeting was suddenly cancelled, after which Andrew Kolvet publicly said he had no White House meeting.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare Kolvet's public denial with White House scheduling records and any cancellation notice for the meeting.
claims.transcript_snippet: Then today they told me the meeting was suddenly cancelled. And suddenly Andrew Kolvet emerges from his 20 25 hour silence and says I have no meeting at the White House.

claims.label: Host Says She Has a Source in Kolvet's Inner Circle
claims.claim: The host says she has a source in Andrew Kolvet's inner circle, which she says he does not believe.
claims.investigative_direction: Only testable through the host's source; ask TPUSA staff whether the host's reporting matched internal knowledge.
claims.transcript_snippet: I did tell you that I have a source in your inner circle. You don't believe me, but it's true.

claims.label: Host Says Feds Released a Blurry Stairwell Still Though Clearer Footage Existed

claims.investigative_direction: Compare the still released during the manhunt with the court exhibit footage and ask the FBI when the clearer footage was available.
claims.transcript_snippet: the feds during this manhunt released chose to release an extremely blurry still image of a man in a stairwell.

claims.label: Host Says Zachariah Karashy Was Arrested, Interrogated and Released
claims.claim: The host says local police went to Zachariah Karashy's apartment in Provo, he was brought in and interrogated by the feds, and then released, and she asks what evidence led to his arrest and why he was let go.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain Provo and Utah County police records, any search or arrest warrant, and FBI interview records for the Karashy detention.
claims.transcript_snippet: the local police decided to go to Zachariah Kareshi's apartment in Provo, whereupon he was then brought in and interrogated by the feds and then released.

claims.label: Host Says Only Two People Were Detained, Zinn and Karashy

claims.investigative_direction: Request the full list of detentions and arrests from Utah County and federal agencies for September 10 to 12, 2025.
claims.transcript_snippet: There was only two people that were detained. The first was George Zinn.

claims.label: Host Says Karashy's Father Owns a Military App Tied to Fort Huachuca
claims.claim: The host says Zachariah Karashy's father is a career military man who owns and operates a military app tied to operations and Fort Huachuca and received a lot of money from the Department of Defense.
claims.investigative_direction: Check DoD contract awards, SAM.gov and company filings for the Karashy family's app company and any Fort Huachuca work.
claims.transcript_snippet: this kid who has got a father who is a career military man who owns and operates a military app tied to operations, tied to Fort Huachuca, got a bunch of money from the DoD.

claims.label: Host Recaps Witness Saying the Rooftop Figure Looked Like a Professional
claims.claim: The host recaps that the only person who captured the figure on the Losee Center rooftop recorded it on his iPhone, reported it to police, and said the person looked professional, with military or tactical training and a military crawl.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the witness's police report and original iPhone file, and the exhibit list from the preliminary hearing.
claims.transcript_snippet: He said that the person looked to him like it was a professional.

claims.label: Host Says the Rooftop Witness Was Not Called by Prosecution or Defense
claims.claim: The host says authorities did not contact the rooftop witness, that the prosecution was not interested in his testimony, that the defense at the preliminary hearing stage was not either, and that his footage was never shown in court.
claims.investigative_direction: Check the preliminary hearing witness lists and exhibits, and ask the witness whether investigators contacted him.
claims.transcript_snippet: Strangely, they didn't contact him. They weren't curious for him to testify. The prosecution wasn't interested.

claims.label: Host Says Tyler and His Partner Never Discussed Politics, Charlie or LGBTQ Issues
claims.claim: The host says that under the official account Tyler Robinson acted for his lover even though they never discussed politics, Charlie Kirk in particular, or LGBTQ issues.
claims.investigative_direction: Review the released Robinson text exchanges and the charging documents for any discussion of politics, Kirk or LGBTQ topics.
claims.transcript_snippet: they never discussed politics and they never discussed Charlie Kirk um in particular and they never discussed LGBTQ issues.

claims.claim: The host says an underground movement for Charlie has built up over ten months, including people in government, and is how she has obtained exclusive information, footage and photos.
claims.investigative_direction: Only testable through the host's sources; ask her to identify provenance for the footage and photos she has aired.

claims.label: Host Says Erika Told Her the Preliminary Hearing Would Be Forthcoming

claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the rifle's specifications and exhibit photos, and test whether such a rifle could be carried in the jeans shown in court footage.
claims.transcript_snippet: The gun is minimum 3'6 in fully assembled. We can see his phone in his right pocket.

claims.label: Host Says Robinson's Limp Disappears Once He Reaches the Rooftop
claims.claim: The host says that in the footage Robinson's limp is gone once he reaches the rooftop and he is suddenly able to sprint.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare gait before and after the rooftop frame by frame, with an independent gait or biomechanics expert.
claims.transcript_snippet: once he hits that rooftop, he is suddenly able to sprint and this limp that he has in the footage is completely removed.
